name: submit_payroll_correction
description: submit_payroll_correction: Submit a payroll correction for a specific shift. Returns a case_id on success. Rejects the correction if the pay period has already closed.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP048271

shift_id.description: The shift being corrected. Format: SHF-YYYYMMDD-HHMM. If the caller only has the shift date and start time, construct the ID from those (e.g. a shift on May 1, 2026 at 7:00 AM becomes SHF-20260501-0700). Example: SHF-20260501-0700

correction_type.description: The type of correction. on_call_hours (on-call time was logged incorrectly or not at all). overtime_hours (overtime beyond scheduled hours was not captured). differential_missed (shift differential pay was not applied to eligible hours).

corrected_hours.description: The corrected total hours for the chosen correction type — not a delta from the current value and not the total shift hours. For overtime_hours: total overtime hours worked. For on_call_hours: total on-call hours. For differential_missed: total hours the differential should have applied to. Must be greater than 0 and at most 24. Example: 8.0
